newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takeda Chemical's shares rise to '97 high.
newsitem.headline: Takeda Chemical's shares rise to '97 high.

text.p: Shares of Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd rose for the fourth consecutive day on Thursday, touching a new high for this calendar year.

Pharmaceutical issues have been attracting investors as they have lagged behind gains in the market and are considered to be defensive stocks which are mostly immune to currency movements and the condition of the economy, traders said.
Takeda's share price briefly hit 3,280 yen. At 0119 GMT, it was up 50 yen at 3,270. Its volume was 678,000 shares.
